modules.name: 数据建模、迁移与数据访问（@nocobase/db）
modules.scope: CRM 三张表的结构、外键级联、索引与阶段枚举，客户详情金额合计，以及样例种子数据；覆盖 collection builder、字段类型、迁移/种子装载与 repository 聚合。
modules.limitations: 未在真实数据库上执行迁移/种子（只读评审）；ApiClient 之外的运行时行为未验证；nocobase-db Skill 的 §4 只核对了聚合入口，未逐条核对全部查询示例。

requirements.need: 客户/联系人/商机三表、外键级联、索引与商机阶段枚举，随迁移可重放
requirements.responsibility: 框架：Collection Builder、FieldType/枚举、外键约束、迁移装载与 dialect 编译；应用：业务字段、关系语义与阶段取值集合。
requirements.actualUsage: 迁移用 defineMigration、builder.createCollection，调用 collection.enum('stage')、foreignKey(onDelete:'cascade') 与 index；enum 未出现在 SKILL 字段构造器清单，Agent 从类型与实现中发现。

requirements.need: 客户详情展示该客户商机金额合计，且只统计该客户
requirements.responsibility: 框架：Repository.aggregate 与 AggregateBuilder 在数据库端求和；应用：过滤条件与数值换算。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 nocobase-db §4 用 repository.aggregate({filter, aggregate}) + aggregate.sum('amount')。
requirements.actualUsage: server/providers/crm.ts 使用 opportunities.aggregate({filter:{customerId}, aggregate:(a)=>({total:a.sum('amount')})})，符合推荐方式。

requirements.need: 准备 2 个客户、3 个联系人、3 条商机的样例数据
requirements.responsibility: 框架：种子运行器与 repository 上下文；应用：决定写入哪些初始数据。
requirements.recommendedUsage: nocobase-db §2 规定种子写入运行所需记录，但明确它'绝不是样例/演示内容'，且未给出样例数据的承载位置。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用把 'Sample data for the sales team' 写入种子文件 _seed_crm_sample_data，没有其它可依据的承载位置。

requirements.need: 种子重复执行不重复插入且不覆盖用户数据
requirements.responsibility: 框架：种子幂等机制（唯一约束 + upsertOne）；应用：选择稳定业务键并声明唯一约束。
requirements.recommendedUsage: nocobase-db §2：以唯一约束支撑稳定业务键，用 upsertOne 直接表达幂等。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用改用 findOne + createOne（按 name/customerId 查找），未声明唯一约束；功能上可重复但不具备数据库唯一性保证。

requirementFit.reason: 字段构造器、外键约束、迁移/种子装载与数据库端聚合都以公开 API 覆盖了本模块需求；唯一指引缺口是 §3 清单漏列 enum，但不影响框架能力本身。

usability.reason: builder API 直观、类型完整，迁移与种子分离清晰；但需要幂等时依赖先建唯一约束，且枚举构造器未在指引清单中出现，须从类型/实现推断。

agentFriendliness.reason: Agent 能依靠类型与实现发现 enum 并正确使用；然而 nocobase-db §3 把字段构造器写得像穷举清单却漏掉 enum，且'种子绝非样例内容'与'准备样例数据'需求冲突时没有任何替代指引。

design.reason: 迁移/种子/字段构造器/仓储职责边界清晰，迁移要求不可变自包含，外键用 ReferentialAction 约束表达，聚合下沉到数据库。

reliability.reason: 实现层对枚举字段的创建/变更/容量做显式守卫并给出可读错误，字段类型与约束在编译期强校验，是可靠基础。

modules.name: 服务装配与 HTTP 路由（@nocobase/app-server + @nocobase/service-provider）
modules.scope: CRM 三个资源端点的装配与认证、业务 provider 的注册/解析、领域错误到 HTTP 状态的映射；覆盖 app-server 路由贡献与服务容器/提供者生命周期。
modules.limitations: 未启动应用，端到端路由行为仅由 verify-2 验收与本机源码核对；未逐一核对 app-server 全部路由助手（repository-routes 等）与容器实现细节。

requirements.need: 客户/联系人/商机的 REST 端点，且全部需要登录
requirements.responsibility: 框架：defineApiRoutes 贡献 + RouterProvider/routerToken 装配 + authenticationToken；应用：路径、方法与业务处理。
requirements.recommendedUsage: server-routes.md：工厂内 new Hono()，从容器解析 authenticationToken，对子路由 router.use('*', auth.required())，不重复写 /api 前缀。
requirements.actualUsage: server/routes/crm.ts 按该模式为三个子路由各自 router.use('*', auth.required())，再经 defineApiRoutes((app)=>...) 挂载。

requirements.need: CRM 领域 service 可被路由解析并复用
requirements.responsibility: 框架：createServiceToken 身份 + ServiceProvider 注册/阶段生命周期 + 容器解析；应用：service 实现与 token 定义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: services-and-jobs.md：createServiceToken 定义 token，ServiceProvider.register 绑定实现，provider 从入口数组注册，路由 container.resolve(token)。
requirements.actualUsage: server/providers/crm.ts 用 createServiceToken + ServiceProvider，并由 server/providers/index.ts 注册。

requirements.need: 领域错误映射为明确 HTTP 状态与用户可读消息
requirements.responsibility: 框架：Hono 上下文与状态码、认证中间件的拒绝；应用：CrmError → 404/400 的映射与文案。
requirements.recommendedUsage: server-routes.md：在工厂内返回 JSON 响应；领域错误到状态码的映射属应用职责。
requirements.actualUsage: server/routes/crm.ts 的 guard() 将 CrmError 映射为 404/400 并返回消息。

requirements.need: 缺必填或金额为负时拒绝保存并说明
requirements.responsibility: 框架：请求体解析与数据库约束；应用：字段级校验规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 未确认：本次校验在应用 service 内实现，未使用框架的声明式请求校验契约。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在服务端自行校验；未见 describeMutation/validateMutation 之类的框架校验入口被使用。

requirementFit.reason: 路由贡献、路由器服务化、token 化的认证与 provider 装配直接覆盖了端点、认证与业务服务组合的需求，应用接入方式与指引一致。

usability.reason: defineApiRoutes 工厂形态与容器解析组合自然，路由贡献和责任边界清楚；认证入口由 token 提供，接入成本低。

agentFriendliness.reason: server-routes.md 与 services-and-jobs.md 给出精确 import 与'每路由自负安全'的硬性提醒，Agent 遵循并在三个子路由上落实认证。

design.reason: 路由器作为服务暴露而非等同于应用，provider 生命周期分阶段，registry 强制注册顺序与命名唯一，职责分离清晰。

reliability.reason: registry 在错误阶段加入或重名时抛错、provider 生命周期状态机化、RouterProvider 经 token 绑定 Hono 实例，装配层有实打实的约束。

modules.name: 客户端路由与 API 调用（@nocobase/app-client）
modules.scope: CRM 页面路由与侧边导航声明，以及前端通过共享 ApiClient 调用后端、用 ApiClientError 呈现服务端消息；覆盖 app-client 的 hooks、路由定义契约与导出。
modules.limitations: @nocobase/api-client 未安装且不在快照中，无法核对其 ApiClient.request 实现与错误语义，客户端可靠性结论仅覆盖 @nocobase/app-client 的 hooks/plugins。

requirements.need: 客户/联系人/商机页面与侧边导航，路由不写 base path
requirements.responsibility: 框架：defineAppRoutes/defineSettingsRoutes 注册与 authz 解析、componentLoader 懒加载；应用：页面组件与导航标题。
requirements.recommendedUsage: page.md：在 client/routes.ts 的 defineAppRoutes([...]) 追加条目，声明 name/path/auth/authz/navigation/componentLoader。
requirements.actualUsage: client/routes.ts 用 defineAppRoutes 声明 CRM 分组与三个子页面，含 authz/componentLoader。

requirements.need: 前端通过共享 HTTP 客户端调用后端，不硬编码 /api
requirements.responsibility: 框架：提供唯一 ApiClient（useApiClient/apiClientToken）与 ApiClientError；应用：端点封装与类型。
requirements.recommendedUsage: api.md：从 @nocobase/app-client 导入 useApiClient/ApiClient/ApiClientError，路径相对 baseURL，禁止 fetch/axios/硬编码 /api。
requirements.actualUsage: client/pages/crm/api.ts 接收 ApiClient 并用 api.request({path:'customers'}) 相对路径；errors.ts 用 instanceof ApiClientError。

requirements.need: 页面操作失败时向用户展示服务端消息
requirements.responsibility: 框架：ApiClientError 语义与共享错误类；应用：文案与展示策略。
requirements.recommendedUsage: api.md：共享同一错误类使 instanceof ApiClientError 可靠，据此取服务端 message。
requirements.actualUsage: client/pages/crm/errors.ts 用 error instanceof ApiClientError 决定展示服务端消息还是兜底文案。

requirementFit.reason: 路由声明契约与共享 ApiClient/错误类直接覆盖页面导航与后端调用需求，应用接入与指引一致。

usability.reason: defineAppRoutes 的声明式条目与 useApiClient 的一行解析降低了接入成本；但 ApiClient 实现不在快照中，调用细节需靠类型与指引。

agentFriendliness.reason: api.md 与 page.md 给出明确 import、禁止项与最小示例，Agent 未自建 client 或硬编码路径。

design.reason: 路由定义与组件懒加载分离，客户端以 token 提供服务解析，错误类跨应用/插件统一。

reliability.reason: hooks 实现限制：useService 在缺少 AppClientRoot 上下文时抛错，保证单例解析；但 ApiClient 本身实现不可核对，故留有余量。

modules.scope: 评估应用开发 Skill 本身：任务到子参考的路由、迁移/种子的职责边界，以及验证建议与工厂验证管线的衔接。

requirements.need: 把页面/端点/数据库任务路由到正确参考，避免通读整库
requirements.responsibility: 指引：任务→参考映射与边界；应用：按图取用。

requirements.actualUsage: Agent 先读 SKILL.md，再按路由读取 migrations/database-and-data/server-routes/services-and-jobs 与前端 references（见原始日志）。

requirements.responsibility: 指引：区分迁移、运行数据与样例数据，并给出承载位置。
requirements.recommendedUsage: nocobase-db §2 规定种子只写运行所需数据、绝非样例内容；应用开发 Skill 与 migrations 参考也未给样例数据留下位置。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用把 2/3/3 样例数据放进种子文件，因为没有任何推荐的替代归属可依。

requirements.need: 本地验证命令与格式化门槛一致
requirements.responsibility: 工厂/模板：verify 验证管线；指引：按影响范围选择检查。
requirements.recommendedUsage: testing.md 建议按变更类型选择对应测试。
requirements.actualUsage: verify-1 因整个工作区 format:check 拒绝未改动的 AGENTS.md，而在 lint/typecheck/test 之前中止；repair 仅删除空行后 verify-2 全链路通过。

requirementFit.reason: 任务路由与迁移/种子边界总体清晰，但样例数据需求没有归属，验证范围建议与工厂固定管线不一致。

design.reason: 把数据库细节外链到 nocobase-db 避免重复，Non-negotiables 简短有力，边界划分合理。

reliability.reason: 指引内容整体准确；样例数据归属缺失与验证范围/格式化门槛不一致是会重复出现的可靠性摩擦。

findings.title: nocobase-db §3 字段构造器清单漏列 enum
findings.detail: SKILL.md 用一行把字段构造器逐项列成清单（increments…native），但漏掉 enum；而 FieldType 联合类型与 fluent builder 都提供 enum，应用也确实用 collection.enum('stage') 定义了商机阶段。清单被写得像穷举，容易让 Agent 误以为枚举不可用或需绕行。
findings.impact: 使用者可能放弃原生枚举字段，转而用字符串+应用校验或 native 类型，削弱数据库层约束与迁移守卫。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 SKILL.md §3 字段构造器清单中补上 enum，并注明其 values 为只读字符串数组及变更枚举成员需显式迁移。

findings.title: 种子'绝非样例内容'与'准备样例数据'需求冲突且无替代归属
findings.detail: nocobase-db §2 明确 a seed is never sample or demonstration content，但本次任务显式要求准备 2 个客户/3 个联系人/3 条商机作为样例数据；nocobase-db 与应用开发 Skill 都未给出样例/演示数据的推荐承载位置，应用只能把 'Sample data' 写进种子文件。
findings.impact: 使用者在'需要可演示数据'的场景下无法判断应放种子、迁移还是其它机制，通常会违反指引放入种子，长期使种子承担双重角色。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-db 或应用开发 Skill 中为样例/演示数据指定明确归属（例如独立 development fixture/二次运行脚本），并说明它与运行所需种子的区别。

findings.title: format:auto 与 format:check 覆盖范围不一致导致未改动文件中止验证
findings.detail: 工厂提交 e318f4e 在 AGENTS.md 引入两个连续空行；format:auto 只格式化本次改动文件，而 verify 的 format:check 扫描整棵工作区树，于是这个未被本次任务触碰的文件使 verify-1 在 lint/typecheck/test 之前中止，repair 仅删除空行即让 verify-2 全绿。
findings.impact: 首轮验证结果不反映 Agent 的代码质量，而由与本次改动无关的历史格式漂移决定，浪费一个验证轮次并误导对任务失败的判断。
findings.suggestedChange: 让 format:check 只检查 changedFiles（与 format:auto 对齐），或在脚手架提交前保证整树已格式化。

findings.title: server-routes 指引的'每路由自负安全'被应用正确落实
findings.detail: server-routes.md 给出 defineApiRoutes 工厂形态、容器解析 authenticationToken 与 router.use('*', auth.required()) 的完整最小示例，并把'挂载在 /api 不提供认证'写成硬性提醒；应用的三个 CRM 子路由都各自执行认证。
findings.impact: 降低了端点在框架迁移中遗漏认证的风险，是可直接复用的安全接入范式。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该示例与硬性提醒；可在测试参考中把匿名 401 的断言与之并列。

findings.title: 集合构造器与数据库端聚合直接覆盖建模与聚合需求
findings.detail: @nocobase/db 的 collection builder 提供 string/decimal/datetime/enum/index/foreignKey(onDelete)，Repository.aggregate + AggregateBuilder.sum 支持数据库端求和；应用用它们定义了 CRM 结构、级联外键与客户金额合计。编译期还对枚举变更与容量做显式守卫。
findings.impact: 常见业务建模（字段、关系、约束、聚合）无需绕行，且约束在编译期与数据库层强校验。
findings.suggestedChange: 无需改动；建议在指引中同步列出 enum 以减少发现成本。

findings.title: app-client 以单一 ApiClient 与统一错误类约束前端接入
findings.detail: @nocobase/app-client 通过 useApiClient/useService 从容器解析唯一 ApiClient 并 re-export ApiClientError，hooks 实现在缺少上下文时抛错；指引要求不得自建 client/fetch/axios 或硬编码 /api。应用按此封装请求并用 instanceof ApiClientError 呈现服务端消息。
findings.impact: 应用与插件共享同一运行时与错误类，避免重复客户端与不一致的错误语义。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现状；补全 api-client 在快照中的可核对性以便独立验证请求实现。

# Calling backend endpoints

Every endpoint request goes through the HTTP client the application provides:

- **Do not** create your own client, do not use `fetch` or axios, do not hard-code `/api`, and do not build endpoint URLs from `location`. The client's `api.baseURL` already includes the deployment base path (for example `/main`).
- Import `useApiClient`, `apiClientToken`, the `ApiClient` type and `ApiClientError` from `@nocobase/app-client`. That way the application and plugins share one runtime and one error class, which is what makes `instanceof ApiClientError` reliable.

## Endpoints and types used in the examples

All code in this handbook comes from the example "projects" domain and assumes the backend provides these endpoints:

| Method and path            | Description                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /api/projects`        | Parameters `search` and `status` (optional); returns `{ data: Project[] }`                                                      |
| `GET /api/projects/:id`    | Returns `{ data: Project }`; 404 if it does not exist                                                                           |
| `POST /api/projects`       | Request body `{ name, owner, status }`; returns `{ data: Project }`; 409 with `code: 'PROJECT_NAME_TAKEN'` for a duplicate name |
| `PATCH /api/projects/:id`  | Changes only the fields sent; returns `{ data: Project }`; 404 if it does not exist                                             |
| `DELETE /api/projects/:id` | 204 on success; 404 if it does not exist                                                                                        |

The frontend types live in the page folder, in `client/pages/projects/types.ts`:

```ts
export const PROJECT_STATUSES = ['planning', 'active', 'done'] as const;

export type ProjectStatus = (typeof PROJECT_STATUSES)[number];

export interface Project {
  readonly id: number;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly owner: string | null;
  readonly status: ProjectStatus;
  readonly updatedAt: string;
}
```

## Getting the client

| Where                               | How                                         |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Components, custom hooks            | `useApiClient()`                            |
| Methods of a client ServiceProvider | `this.app.services.resolve(apiClientToken)` |
| Plain functions                     | Passed in by the caller, typed `ApiClient`  |

- `useApiClient()` is the same as `useService(apiClientToken)`: both return the current application's one client, and both can only be called inside the application (below `AppClientRoot`). It does not create a client and does not manage request state: you write loading and failure handling yourself (see "Loading data in a component").
- Do not create or resolve the client at module top level.


This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

# NocoBase 3 application development

Use this Skill when building a feature in this application: a page, an endpoint, a table, a service, or the tests covering them.

Do not use it to develop a published plugin package. Plugin development has its own protocol and lives in a separate repository.

Do not use it to upgrade the template this application was generated from. That is `.agents/skills/nocobase-app-upgrade/`, which reconciles a newer template release against the application without reverting the user's work.

## Before you start

Read the application's `AGENTS.md` first for the rules that apply everywhere. This Skill's references are the detail behind it. Before running any `pnpm nocobase` command, read [the command line](references/cli.md): it maps tasks to commands and states the flags an agent must not add on its own.

Confirm you are in an application and not a plugin package. An application has:

```text
client/runtime.ts
server/runtime.ts
config.example.yml
```

If instead you find `client/plugin.ts`, `server/plugin.ts`, or a `defineServerPlugin()` declaration, you are in a plugin package and this Skill does not apply.

Do not infer the application's capabilities from a template name or from this Skill. Inspect `package.json`, `client/plugins.ts`, `server/plugins.ts`, `cli/plugins.ts`, `server/config/index.ts`, and `database/` before deciding what is installed, registered, configured, or application-owned. `nocobase.templatePackage` and `nocobase.templateKind` identify known template ancestry when present, but a new template remains valid without being listed here. Read [template variants](references/template-variants.md) only when those files identify one of the documented official templates.

## The one rule that decides most tasks

Build the feature in the application. Do not run a plugin generator, create a `packages/plugins/` directory, or write a `defineServerPlugin()` declaration for this application's own feature. Create a plugin only when the user explicitly asks for an independently published, reusable package.

## Check the installed plugins first

NocoBase packages may publish Skills under `.agents/skills/`. Current application templates run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` automatically through `postinstall`; run it manually if install scripts were disabled or that directory is missing or stale. Confirm that the package is a direct `@nocobase/*` dependency or a registered plugin before relying on its Skill. The common capability mappings are:

| The requirement sounds like                                                                   | Read the Skill for                    |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Approvals, multi-step processes, "when X happens then Y"                                      | `@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow`       |
| An assistant in the app: chat, reading files dropped into it, acting through tools you define | `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee`    |
| Email, IM, or in-app messages                                                                 | `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification`   |
| Roles, permissions, per-user or per-record access                                             | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization`  |
| Sign-in, registration, sessions                                                               | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` |
| File upload and metadata through Repository                                                   | `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`           |
| Translated text and language switching                                                        | `@nocobase/app-plugin-i18n`           |
| User administration and application-owned role assignment                                     | `@nocobase/app-plugin-users`          |
| Reading or writing data, schema changes, migrations                                           | `@nocobase/db`                        |

Read the relevant Skill before writing the feature, but treat this table as a map rather than an installed-package list. Implementing a permission system, a notification sender, or a scheduler by hand when a registered plugin provides one is the most expensive mistake available here.

For notification configuration or sending, follow the notification plugin Skill: `notification.channels` maps each name to one flat Provider configuration, and `send({ idempotencyKey, messages })` supplies a complete message per Channel. Use native addresses; email and in-app arrays create independent deliveries, while Webhooks forbid `to`.

Skills synchronization reads direct `@nocobase/*` dependencies from the application manifest and retains compatibility with explicitly registered plugins. It does not make an unregistered runtime plugin active; the composition roots remain the authority for registration and contribution order.

Install plugins with `pnpm nocobase plugin register <name>`. All application plugins belong in `dependencies`, including client-only and disabled plugins, because deployment dependencies come from that field. Plugin frontend libraries remain peers and are not automatically installed in the deployment. Re-registering migrates legacy `devDependencies` entries while preserving the declared range; verify the manifest and lockfile afterward. With an older CLI, use `pnpm add --save-prod <package>@<declared-range>` to correct the declaration; `--no-install` leaves lockfile synchronization to the caller.

To update a registered plugin, use `pnpm nocobase plugin update @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` (or the short name `authentication`). Omit the name to update all registered plugins; add `--dry-run` to preview. `plugin update` takes a positional name, not `--plugin`, and re-synchronizes Skills after a successful package update. See the Plugins section of the application's `README.MD` for version-range behavior and examples.

## Removing a direct NocoBase package

Before removing an `@nocobase/*` dependency, search the application's imports, Client/Server/CLI plugin registrations, routes, services, configuration, tests, and build scripts for the package name and the contracts it provides. Migrate or remove those references first. `package remove` updates dependency metadata and generated Skills; it does not rewrite application code or configuration and cannot decide whether the capability is still needed.

Run `pnpm nocobase package remove @nocobase/example`. The command uses the application's package manager to update `package.json` and the lockfile, then removes only synchronized Skills recorded as owned by that package. An `@nocobase/app-plugin-*` target delegates to the plugin unregister workflow so its Client, Server, and CLI registrations are removed together; `pnpm nocobase plugin unregister <name>` remains available. Use `--dry-run` before a consequential removal and `--json` when structured output is needed.

After an interrupted or manual removal, verify that the manifest no longer declares the package and run a full `pnpm nocobase skills sync` to reconcile stale package-owned output. Passing an already-absent package to `package remove` cleans recorded historical Skill ownership without uninstalling or cleaning another package.

## Frontend work

Before writing or changing anything under `client/` — pages, components, styles, copy — read [the frontend workflow](references/frontend/ui-workflow.md). It decides whether the change takes the full workflow (a design file reviewed once, then an independent acceptance review) or a quick change (edit directly, static checks only), and which parts of [the UI guidelines](references/frontend/ui-guidelines.md) and [the frontend handbook](references/frontend/frontend-dev.md) to read at each step.

The handbook routes each frontend task to its document: pages, routes and navigation; child routes and Tabs; dialogs, drawers and confirmations; forms and validation; calling endpoints; lists and tables; styling, header actions and dark mode; theme tokens and presets; copy and translations; frontend tests. Its styling document explains how to start a screen from the worked pages in `client/pages/reference/`.

## Choose your reference

Read the page for the task in front of you. Do not read all of them.

| Task                                                                                                 | Read                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Anything under `client/`: pages, routes, components, styling, forms, API calls, copy, frontend tests | [frontend workflow](references/frontend/ui-workflow.md), then [frontend handbook](references/frontend/frontend-dev.md) |
| Add an API endpoint, a webhook, or a callback; authenticate and authorize it                         | [server routes](references/server-routes.md)                                                                           |
| Query or write data, resolve the database, work with transactions                                    | [database and data access](references/database-and-data.md)                                                            |
| Create a table, alter a column, add an index, write required initial data                            | [migrations and seeds](references/migrations.md)                                                                       |
| Switch the database, register a dialect, add a second connection                                     | [database connections](references/database-connections.md)                                                             |
| Translate server-produced text, add a language, set the default language                             | [internationalization](references/i18n.md)                                                                             |

"symptom": "`pnpm format:check '!.github/**'` reported `[warn] AGENTS.md` and exited 1. Because verify.sh uses `set -e` and stops at the first failing check, lint, typecheck and test never executed in the previous attempt.",
      "rootCause": "AGENTS.md contained two consecutive blank lines between the 'Factory task termination' and 'Controlled failed-delivery smoke' sections. Git blame attributes the extra blank line to factory commit e318f4e, which appended the failure-smoke section after an existing blank line. The repair-loop `format:auto` step only formats changed/untracked files, so it never touched the unchanged AGENTS.md, while `format:check` scans the whole tree.",
      "resolution": "Removed the duplicate blank line in AGENTS.md with Prettier (formatting-only change, no wording altered). Verified the complete chain afterwards: format:check, lint, typecheck, all 324 tests, and the production build all pass.",
